bio: Burnished copper saucepans and a striking colour scheme set the stylish scene in this welcoming restaurant. The youthful chef, Louis Wauters, is a butcher’s son and proud of it. You will sample perfectly cooked rib of beef with a silky béarnaise sauce and French fries, but the chef is also keen to pamper fish and seafood amateurs. Flavour and generosity are the watchwords here....
